newsitem.title: FRANCE: French SNCF rail says 1998 breakeven possible.
newsitem.headline: French SNCF rail says 1998 breakeven possible.

text.p: France's loss-making SNCF state railways will reach breakeven at overall group level in 1998 if the economic outlook and transport regulation remain stable, a spokesman for the SNCF quoted chairman Louis Gallois as saying on Tuesday.

The spokesman, who was speaking as a modernisation plan for the SNCF was being presented to an employee committee, said that Gallois had spelled out his expectations for the railways in a letter to Prime Minister Alain Juppe.
The SNCF reported a group net loss of 16.5 billion francs in 1995 after one of 8.42 billion in 1994.
Breakeven in each of the SNCF's activities is expected by the year 2000, the spokesman added.
